about: Mechanics for the character builder, keyed by the IDs in the Player's Handbook (2024) CSVs. Names, summaries, levels, tables and lists come from the CSVs; this file only says what the rules DO. Each source lists effects; see README-character-builder.md for every effect type and how to add house rules.
